lines: This tiny engine beats an eight-billion parameter LLM. It's eleven times faster.
It compresses your agent's entire session into a memory key. Then injects it back when you return.
Over ninety-seven thousand stars prove its reliability. Works with Claude Code and every major agent.
Search returns a compact index in fifty to one hundred tokens only.
Run the installer command for your specific IDE today. Restart your code editor and it works instantly.
Send this to someone who needs persistent context across sessions. Save now for later use.
